title: aidw target-repo config
description: Schema for <target>/aidw/config.yaml (AIDT EXTRACTION.md §3.4, task E3.1). Unknown keys are rejected at every object level. Toolkit defaults are applied by E3.2/E3.4 and are deliberately not expressed here: this file describes the config file, not the resolved config.

schema_version.description: Config schema version understood by the toolkit (D10). Required whenever this file exists.

max_revisions.description: Revision budget for the prompt workflow (design.md §12). The toolkit's default is applied by E3.2.

base_branch.description: PR base branch and branch point.

branch_pattern.description: Branch and worktree name template built from task ids.

paths.description: Per-repo path conventions; values are strings, resolved by later tasks.

agent_configs_dir.description: Optional target-repo agent-config directory whose *.yaml files shadow the toolkit's agent-configs/ by id (E4.6). A read-path when named; unset means the toolkit defaults.

workflows.description: Open map keyed by workflow name (D12 lets a repo add stages).

github.description: Markers and labels persisted to GitHub (D5 / §3.9).

labels.description: Open map keyed by label name.

enabled.description: Repo-optional stages are disabled explicitly with false (§3.5, D12).

model.description: Per-stage model override (E4.6): a provider/model id applied to the stage's agent for this stage only. Replaces model, never provider.

thinking.description: Per-stage thinking level (design §5.1), applied for this stage only (E4.6).

timeout_seconds.description: Per-stage wall-clock timeout in seconds (E4.6); must be positive.

when_paths.description: Repo-relative path prefixes a when=paths-changed stage must touch to run (S1.1, design §12.2). Optional; absent or empty means unconditional.

label.description: Exactly a colour and a description; both are required (D5).
